title: Tribal and subtribal delimitation and phylogeny of the Cardueae (Asteraceae): a combined nuclear and chloroplast DNA analysis
sampling: broad Cardueae representation
principal_inference: Established an early molecular framework for tribal and subtribal limits but left difficult backbone nodes weakly resolved.
known_limit: few loci; vulnerable to lineage sorting and organelle history
EAzami_relevance: historical baseline only; not adequate for East Asian colour-state reconstruction

title: The Cardueae (Compositae) revisited: insights from ITS, trnL-trnF, and matK nuclear and chloroplast DNA analysis
sampling: tribal representatives
principal_inference: Refined Cardueae relationships and exposed persistent discordance/low support in difficult lineages.
known_limit: three loci and limited gene-tree representation
EAzami_relevance: useful nomenclatural/history context; superseded for deep nodes by Hyb-Seq

title: Nuclear and plastid DNA phylogeny of tribe Cardueae (Compositae) with Hyb-Seq data: A new subtribal classification and a temporal diversification framework
markers_or_loci: Compositae1061 COS targets plus 87 plastid genes
sampling: 76 Cardueae species
principal_inference: Highly resolved Cardueae backbone and 12-subtribe classification; some cytonuclear discordance persisted.
known_limit: sparse within Carduus-Cirsium and almost no population replication
EAzami_relevance: best deep backbone/outgroup framework; machine-readable trees are openly archived

title: A prickly puzzle: Generic delimitations in the Carduus-Cirsium group (Compositae: Cardueae: Carduinae)
markers_or_loci: ETS; ITS; matK; ndhF; psbA-trnH; trnL-trnF
sampling: broad Carduus-Cirsium group
principal_inference: Recovered major clades and offered either a single broad genus or multiple monophyletic genera as taxonomic solutions.
known_limit: six loci; sparse sampling relative to current phylogenomics
EAzami_relevance: important because accepted names/generic boundaries remain hypothesis-dependent

title: Towards a monophyletic classification of Cardueae: restoration of the genus Lophiolepis (= Cirsium p.p.) and new circumscription of Epitrachys
sampling: Cirsium sect. Eriolepis and C. italicum focus
principal_inference: Restored Lophiolepis and segregated Epitrachys to preserve monophyletic generic concepts.
known_limit: taxonomic conclusion depends on circumscription and incomplete global taxon sampling
EAzami_relevance: requires synonym-aware taxon table and sensitivity to Cirsium s.l. versus segregate genera

title: African Mountain Thistles: Three New Genera in the Carduus-Cirsium Group
markers_or_loci: 986 nuclear loci and 177 plastid regions after filtering
sampling: 190 samples; 159 species; all Carduinae genera
principal_inference: Highly resolved Carduinae tree; recognized Afrocarduus, Afrocirsium and Nuriaea; documented nuclear/coalescent/plastid incongruence.
known_limit: not designed for dense Cirsium species/population sampling; generic treatment disputed
EAzami_relevance: shows genus-level reticulation/discordance and provides compatible Compositae1061 framework
data_or_access: open article and public sequence data

title: Evolution of genome size and GC content in the tribe Carduinae (Asteraceae): rare descending dysploidy and polyploidy, limited environmental control and strong phylogenetic signal
markers_or_loci: seven genetic markers; genome size; GC; chromosomes
sampling: 119 taxa
principal_inference: Polyploidy was uncommon in sampled Carduinae; genomic and phylogenetic evidence supported Lophiolepis and flagged C. vulgare/C. italicum as problematic.
known_limit: marker tree rather than phylogenomic species tree; population sampling uneven
EAzami_relevance: strong evidence that ploidy/genome-size metadata must accompany East Asian sampling

title: Intergeneric hybrid origin of the invasive tetraploid Cirsium vulgare
sampling: 8 C. vulgare; 11 Lophiolepis species; 12 Cirsium species
principal_inference: Demonstrated allotetraploid Cirsium x Lophiolepis origin, with organelles inherited from Cirsium.
known_limit: single hybrid taxon and limited representatives; RAD loci not a reusable global backbone
EAzami_relevance: direct warning that one bifurcating tree and plastid genealogy can misrepresent flower-colour allele history

title: The Genus Lophiolepis Is at Least as Well Supported as Afrocarduus, Afrocirsium, and Nuriaea
markers_or_loci: interpretation of published phylogenomic and genomic evidence
sampling: not a new sampling study
principal_inference: Argued that Lophiolepis is well supported and that Cirsium including it is not monophyletic under their reading.
known_limit: comment; taxonomic interpretation rather than new broad dataset
EAzami_relevance: must retain alternative generic concepts in the synonym/accepted-name layer

title: Reply to Del Guacchio et al. The Genus Lophiolepis Is at Least as Well Supported as Afrocarduus, Afrocirsium, and Nuriaea
sampling: not a new sampling study
principal_inference: Defended their broader Cirsium treatment and clarified differences in evidential and taxonomic criteria.
known_limit: reply; no new comprehensive sampling
EAzami_relevance: confirms that generic circumscription is not settled and should not drive biological transition counts by itself

title: A thorny tale: The origin and diversification of Cirsium (Compositae)
sampling: 299 plants; 251 taxa; 266 Cirsium accessions representing 248 species
principal_inference: Largest Cirsium backbone to date; Western Palearctic origin; Pleistocene radiations in Japan and North America; some conflict attributed to hybridization/ILS.
known_limit: approximately 60% of genus; mostly one/few accessions per species; exact supplement/tree recovery incomplete
EAzami_relevance: primary species-level nuclear backbone and source for deciding genuine RAD gaps
data_or_access: PRJNA957074; Supplementary Data 1; exact Newick still being recovered

title: Phylogeny and ecological radiation of New World thistles (Cirsium, Cardueae-Compositae) based on ITS and ETS rDNA sequence data
sampling: 35 North American taxa cited by later audit
principal_inference: Low rDNA divergence and a California radiation; raised rapid-radiation versus conserved-rDNA alternatives.
known_limit: few loci; low divergence; no genomic/population resolution
EAzami_relevance: historical evidence for rapid radiation, not adequate for East Asian backbone

title: Phylogeny of Cirsium spp. in North America: Host Specificity Does Not Follow Phylogeny
sampling: native and introduced Great Plains Cirsium plus allied thistles
principal_inference: Produced a regional tree for host-specificity questions but did not resolve fine species relationships broadly.
known_limit: two linked rDNA regions; limited geographic/taxon sampling
EAzami_relevance: low-priority historical comparison

title: Thistle be a mess: Untangling the taxonomy of Cirsium (Cardueae: Compositae) in North America
sampling: broad North American sampling with species-variety complexes
principal_inference: Eight species-variety complexes were polyphyletic; convergence, hybridization and incipient speciation contribute to taxonomic difficulty.
known_limit: few loci and species-complex focus
EAzami_relevance: supports population/morph-level coding rather than forcing one colour per accepted species

title: Diversification and Biogeography of North American Thistles (Cirsium: Carduoideae: Compositae): Drivers of a Rapid Continent-Wide Radiation
sampling: 64 North American taxa
principal_inference: North American radiation originated about 2 Ma with Pleistocene bursts; precipitation and semiaridity were major diversification correlates.
known_limit: regional taxa and mostly species-level tips; not an East Asian population tree
EAzami_relevance: demonstrates value of target capture for recent radiation and supplies methodological precedent

title: Genome size variation in Central European species of Cirsium (Compositae) and their natural hybrids
sampling: 13 taxa; 12 natural hybrid combinations; 102 populations
principal_inference: Documented genome-size variation, diploid hybrids, triploidy and a tetraploid C. vulgare; genome size related to hybridization propensity.
known_limit: not a sequence phylogeny; geography restricted
EAzami_relevance: basis for mandatory ploidy/cytotype metadata and avoiding diploid assumptions

title: Pollen viability and natural hybridization of Central European species of Cirsium
markers_or_loci: AFLP genetic distance plus pollen and distribution data
sampling: 13 species; 16 natural hybrids; 163 field populations
principal_inference: Natural hybrids were often pollen-fertile and viability covaried with parental distance and sympatry, supporting recurrent introgression potential.
known_limit: regional and not a species-tree analysis
EAzami_relevance: supports explicit network/introgression alternatives for colour histories

title: Cirsium x sudae: a new interspecific hybrid between rare Alpine thistles
sampling: four hybrid individuals and parental taxa
principal_inference: Confirmed homoploid F1 hybrids and a backcross between C. carniolicum and C. greimleri.
known_limit: single local hybrid system
EAzami_relevance: empirical precedent that backcrossing can blur trait-state and species-tree correspondence

title: Chromosome number variation and phylogenetic divergence of East Asian Cirsium sect. Onotrophe subsect. Nipponocirsium (Compositae), with a new species from Taiwan
markers_or_loci: thousands of transcriptome orthogroups plus chromosome/pollen/morphology
sampling: seven focal Cirsium species across Taiwan and Japan
principal_inference: Resolved Japanese and Taiwanese clades; inferred recent Pleistocene divergences with dysploidy and tetraploidization.
known_limit: one subsection and few samples per species; population gene flow only partly addressed
EAzami_relevance: best local nuclear anchor for C. kawakamii white-loss replicate and ploidy-aware design

title: Karyotype analysis and taxonomic insights of Cirsium (Compositae) in Taiwan
sampling: 12 indigenous Taiwanese taxa
principal_inference: Most taxa had 2n=34 but 2n=30/32 and diagnostic satellite/karyotype differences occurred.
known_limit: cluster analysis of cytology is not a nuclear species tree
EAzami_relevance: critical ploidy/cytotype covariate and specimen source for Taiwanese sampling

title: Phylotranscriptomics and genome-size evidence clarify the Taiwanese Cirsium japonicum complex and delimit C. brevicaule and allied East Asian thistles
markers_or_loci: 4083 orthogroups in primary ASTRAL analysis plus genome-size/morphology
sampling: 37 samples; 33 Cirsium samples; 12 Cirsium taxa
principal_inference: Resolved Sinocirsium, Arenicola and Nipponocirsium framework; delimited C. brevicaule and C. irumtiense; revealed reticulation/ILS signals in Taiwan complex.
known_limit: limited taxon/population coverage for all East Asia; exact machine-readable trees still being recovered
EAzami_relevance: primary backbone for Arenicola and takaoense regain-versus-parallel-loss hypotheses

title: Chromosome Evolution in Korean Carduus-Cirsium Taxa (Asteraceae)
sampling: nine Korean Cirsium taxa plus Carduus crispus
principal_inference: Documented diploids, tetraploid 2n=68, aneuploidy and B chromosomes; karyotypes informative at species rather than section level.
known_limit: not a sequence phylogeny
EAzami_relevance: identifies Korean cytotype complexity that RAD/target capture must model

title: A taxonomic study of the genus Cirsium in Korea based on morphological characters
sampling: 8 species; 3 varieties; 5 forms reported in Korean revision
principal_inference: Provided Korean taxon/form circumscription and historical white-form nomenclature.
known_limit: no molecular phylogeny and older species concepts
EAzami_relevance: source for candidate white morph names, never sufficient to count independent transitions

title: The complete chloroplast genome of Korean endemic species, Cirsium rhinoceros (H.Lev. & Vaniot) Nakai (Asteraceae)
sampling: one C. rhinoceros accession; six Cirsium in tree
principal_inference: Provided maternal plastome and a small organellar placement for the Jeju endemic.
known_limit: single accession; maternal genealogy; tiny phylogenetic sampling
EAzami_relevance: does not close the nuclear gap for the historical white-form candidate

title: The complete chloroplast genome of Cirsium setosum and its phylogenetic analysis
sampling: one C. setosum accession; 12 plastomes in tree
principal_inference: Placed C. setosum near C. arvense in a small plastome tree.
known_limit: maternal single-locus genome; sparse taxon representation
EAzami_relevance: example of Chinese sequence availability that must not be treated as nuclear species-tree coverage

title: The complete chloroplast genome of Cirsium shansiense and its phylogenetic analysis
sampling: single focal accession with a small plastome comparison
principal_inference: Added organellar data for a Chinese backbone candidate.
known_limit: not a multi-locus nuclear placement and cannot resolve introgression/chloroplast capture
EAzami_relevance: retains C. shansiense as a nuclear-coverage audit target rather than a resolved tip

title: Phylogenomic matrices and trees for Nuclear and plastid DNA phylogeny of tribe Cardueae
markers_or_loci: HybPiper and PHYLUCE nuclear datasets; plastid dataset; dating appendices
sampling: same 76-species Cardueae study
principal_inference: Makes deep-backbone topology and uncertainty reproducible.
known_limit: not dense within Cirsium
EAzami_relevance: can be directly imported as a deep topology component/outgroup reference

title: NCBI BioProject for A thorny tale: PRJNA957074
sampling: project-linked accessions from Moreyra et al. 2025
principal_inference: Public reads can reconstruct actual sampled tips even when supplements are difficult to retrieve.
known_limit: run metadata may omit unsequenced/supplement-only tips and uses submitted names
EAzami_relevance: primary source for verifying whether focal taxa truly lack modern nuclear data
